content.name: prefix
content.description: Set the prefix of your bot here

content.name: botOperators
content.description: Bot operators can reload the configuration and perform system relevant actions with this bot. Please only add users you really trust (and yourself of course)

content.name: guildID
content.description: Replace this the id of the guild the bot should work in.

content.name: disableStatus
content.description: If enabled, the bot won't have a status in discord

content.name: user_presence
content.default: Change this in your Bot-Configuration on scnx.app: https://scootk.it/change-status
content.description: This will show up in Discord as "Playing <YourValue>"

content.name: logLevel
content.description: Log-Level of the bot. Leave it as it is, if you don't know what this means

content.name: logChannelID
content.description: Default log-channel for most modules and used to log relevant information

content.name: disableEveryoneProtection
content.description: Allows @everyone and @here pings for messages configurable in the dashboard

content.name: disableFileArchival
content.description: When archival is enabled (recommended), the bot uploads Discord attachments (images, videos, files) to your scnx CDN so the starboard, moderation evidence, deleted-message logs and anti-nuke sticker restores keep working after Discord's signed URLs expire (usually within hours). Disabling this stops all uploads to scnx — no data leaves the bot for archival — but those features will silently break once Discord's short-lived URLs expire. Archived files count against your guild's file-storage quota (view current usage: https://scnx.app/glink?page=images). Free-plan guilds may run out of space and need to upgrade or delete files to keep archival working.

content.name: syncCommandGlobally
content.humanName: Sync module commands as global commands
content.description: If enabled, module-commands will be synced to discord as global commands. They will show up on other servers, but won't work. Syncing can take up to 2 hours, so changes may not be reflected immediately.
